definitions.explanation: The feeling of regret or anger at one's own failure or inability to do something.

examples.japanese: {負|ま}けた{悔|くや}しさをバネにして{練習|れんしゅう}した。
examples.english: I used the frustration of losing as motivation to practice.

examples.japanese: {悔|くや}しさで{涙|なみだ}が{出|で}た。
あの{時|とき}の{悔|くや}しさは{今|いま}でも{忘|わす}れられない。
examples.english: I still can't forget the frustration from that time.

notes:
{悔|くや}しさ is the noun form of {悔|くや}しい.

FORMATION:
{悔|くや}しい (i-adjective) → {悔|くや}しさ (noun)

NUANCE:
Combines frustration at failure, anger at oneself, regret, and sometimes competitive drive.

COLLOCATIONS:
・{悔|くや}しさを{感|かん}じる - to feel frustration
・{悔|くや}しさをバネにする - to use frustration as motivation
・{悔|くや}しさがこみ{上|あ}げる - frustration wells up
・{悔|くや}しさで{泣|な}く - to cry from frustration

SIMILAR EMOTION NOUNS:
・{悲|かな}しさ - sadness (from {悲|かな}しい)
・{嬉|うれ}しさ - happiness (from {嬉|うれ}しい)
